episodes.title: To You in 2016
episodes.description: Shizuka lives a painful life until things take a sudden turn when she meets an alien named Takopi.

episodes.title: Takopi's Salvation
episodes.description: Takopi makes various attempts to help Shizuka, but things don't seem to work in his favor.

episodes.title: Takopi's Confession
episodes.description: Takopi realizes something important while covering up the crime with Shizuka and Naoki.

episodes.title: Azuma-kun's Salvation
episodes.description: Naoki struggles between his conscience and his desire to help Shizuka.

episodes.title: To You in 2022
episodes.description: Shizuka goes to Tokyo, and Takopi remembers something very important that happened in the past.

episodes.title: To All of You in 2016
episodes.description: Takopi makes an important decision that will save not only Shizuka but also Marina and Naoki.
